posts.author: K_Bowman
posts.body: So, I have a character who I want to gain a new weapon when he transforms and gains the ability to equip that type. I know how to make him able to equip the weapon type while in that state, but I don't know how to force him to equip the weapon since I want him to have it locked in after he transforms.

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
Hello there! Could you
please review this post and add more information
as I can only guess at what your issue might be?
Assuming this all happens outside of battle, you can just force equip any weapon using an event command, and then add the trait "lock equip" to make it so that the weapon cannot be changed.

This is an in battle transformation where I wanted to force equip a weapon that the character could not normally equip but gains the ability to while transformed. For example, he can normally equip swords but gains access to claws when he transforms. I think I figured something out, though. I made a weapon that I called a sword but has claw properties, animations, and graphics since they only show up as part of the transformation.

posts.author: sunhihi
posts.body:
I personally developed this kind of plugin,
but it doesn't support VisuStella
and it also depends on a lot of prerequisite plugins.
Its function allows you to forcibly change the equipment a character is wearing through a state.
When the state is removed, the equipment automatically reverts to the original setup.
